metadata.description: Ready-to-install skills and plugins for Codex and Claude Code.

plugins.name: agent-harness
plugins.description: Agent harness design and evaluation plus Codex and Claude runtime operations, cross-task corpora, secret-safe credential handoff, sessions, deferred completion, and scheduler proof.

plugins.name: windows-host-operations
plugins.description: Windows host diagnosis and controlled repair across effective settings, startup and removal surfaces, and device stacks with rollback and functional proof.

plugins.name: capability-workbench
plugins.description: Artifact-first agent capability engineering for skills, plugins, guidance, and trigger contracts: frame behavior gaps, evaluate baselines and candidates, author validated changes, govern portfolios, and activate explicitly. Use Agent Harness for runtime and harness-level evaluation.

plugins.name: context-density
plugins.description: Agent context audits measure token cost, validate prompt/output contracts and typed state, test compression, and route structural skill or plugin overlap to Capability Workbench.

plugins.name: i-have-adhd
plugins.description: Explicit opt-in focus formatting turns the current response into short numbered steps, visible progress, concrete time boxes, calm recovery, and one next action.

plugins.name: git-workflows
plugins.description: Git code review, GitLab discussion response, stacked-change delivery, worktree recovery, and SSH commit-signing recovery use exact-state, capability-selected, fail-closed workflows.

plugins.name: engineering-hygiene
plugins.description: Engineering hygiene audits changed code, untangles business logic, inspects rendered UI, and provisions missing tools with evidence-first, touched-surface discipline.

plugins.name: scientific-research
plugins.description: Scholarly research discovers papers, deduplicates DOIs, extracts source-backed claims, and validates evidence across arXiv, OpenAlex, Crossref, Europe PMC, Semantic Scholar, PubMed, and OpenCitations.

plugins.name: technology-intelligence
plugins.description: Capability-first technology decisions map needs to candidate products and documented CLI/SDK/WASM/MCP/API/skill interfaces using dated evidence, explicit gaps, and separate runtime facts.

plugins.name: design-intelligence
plugins.description: Product, UX, and technical visual explanations grounded in evidence: framing, information architecture, interaction, usability/accessibility review, compact diagrams, and design-system governance; excludes Figma, CSS, and framework recipes.

plugins.name: architecture-intelligence
plugins.description: Software architecture audits and decisions grounded in source evidence: boundaries, AI-assisted code architecture, ownership/runtime topology, async state consistency, conformance, ADRs, fitness functions, and staged refactoring.

plugins.name: spec-driven-development
plugins.description: Spec-Driven Development routes intent through specs, plans, traceable tasks, implementation, and proof.

plugins.name: build-swift-apps
plugins.description: Build, debug, profile, test, refactor, and release Swift apps across iOS, macOS, Xcode, SwiftUI, SwiftPM, Tuist, and App Store Connect.

plugins.name: kotlin-multiplatform
plugins.description: Kotlin Multiplatform design, Gradle repair, Compose UI, data/interop architecture, migration, testing, governance, security, performance, CI, publishing, and readiness review.

plugins.name: tauri
plugins.description: Tauri 2 project scaffolding/migration, security, Rust IPC/plugins, shell UI, debugging, testing, packaging, signing, updates, and desktop/mobile release.

plugins.name: pixijs
plugins.description: PixiJS v8 scene tooling builds and debugs Applications, assets, events, filters, shaders, performance, v7 migrations, and create-pixi projects.

plugins.name: game-design-intelligence
plugins.description: Game design judgment grounded in evidence: core loops, gameplay systems, progression/economy/balance, motivation/retention, onboarding/difficulty, and multiplayer/live-service health; excludes engines, graphics, assets, and code.

plugins.name: career
plugins.description: Evidence-first career support for direction, research, job discovery, materials, applications and campaigns, inbox and recruiter coordination, interviews, offers, operations, development, and data governance.
